Sam: heads-up — APAC prod cluster lost 24 H100s overnight, nodes evicting.
Sam: vendor replied: 18 units are sitting in the FRA depot, 6 marked DOA/in-transit flagged for RMA at origin.
Sam: need a decision: split the AWB and air-expedite 6 now (~$12k landed) or consolidate and wait ~10 days for sea->road consolidation (no expedite cost).
Priya: can you drop AWB/serials? also which depot in FRA and depot hours (we might be able to intake some today).
VendorOps: AWB: 123-45678901 (FRA depot GLA-DC), AWB: 123-45678902 (origin RMA hold). Serials (sample): H100-AX12-0001..H100-AX12-0024. Depot contact: fra-depot-ops@vendor.com, window 08:00-16:00 CET. Customs note: one pallet flagged for HS reclass; could trigger full hold if not split.
Marco: short-term ops ask — how many committed slots are impacted? If we expedite 6 by air we cover critical canary + 2 capacity units; rest will be backfilled. Cross-region borrow (EU->APAC) is ~4-6h provisioning + $1800 per chassis transfer.
Sam: committed slots: 16 reserved for Dedicated customers, 8 spare for host tier. We can't exhaust pooled spare across customers without notice.
VendorOps: ETA options:
- Air split (send 6 expedited): 48h including customs pre-clear, vendor covers expedited uplift except fuel surcharge.
- FRA depot split + road: 96-120h if customs clears quickly.
- Full consolidation: ~10 days sea+road.
We can offer 15% credit on expedite uplift if you take the split AWB now. Link to pro forma: https://vendor.example.com/proforma/EXP-3355
Priya: depot can intake 12 units today if we provide AWB docs and customs paperwork before 11:30 CET. I'll ping customs team.
Logistics: recommend splitting AWB to separate the flagged pallet; flagged pallet serials H100-AX12-0019..0024. If we keep them together customs will escalate and hold entire shipment.
Marco: also note—if we air 6 and intake 12 to depot, cluster will still be short 6 for peak. Consider temporarily shifting low-priority batch training to off-peak or reduce batch sizes to preserve latency SLOs.
Sam: agreed plan: split AWB; expedite 6 by air (take vendor credit), intake 12 at FRA depot today, open temporary schedule to throttle non-critical jobs. @Finance please prep for expedite charge with vendor credit applied.
Finance: acknowledged — will pre-approve up to $15k for expedite with vendor credit. Please attach pro forma to the GL ticket.
Priya: uploading docs to shared folder and emailing depot now. https://redwood-internal.share/docs/rma/3355556789
deploy-bot: routing policy updated: apac-fallback -> eu-repool for GPU allocations for next 72h. Canary throttle set to 50% for training queue.
Sam: thanks everyone — tracking ticket created: infra#8421. I'll update customers in the next 30m. :thumbsup:
